# Text styles of the measured widgets (generated, do not edit)

Generated by `node tools/print_anatomy.js --fonts`. Sizes are design points (CSS px at scale 1); `normal` line height means the font's own. Colours are the computed CSS colours; `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` is gradient-filled text (gilt or steel): the colour comes from the gradient, see styles.json and fx.json `.gx-gilt` / `.gx-steel`.
